name: Matilda - Knowledgable, Professional
provenance: Voice identity confirmed by provider search and original walkthrough metadata. Original per-generation settings were not persisted; these are explicit new conversational settings, not claimed recovered settings.

narration.opportunity: Your practice may already have opportunities that aren’t turning into appointments. Some are patients who haven’t been back in a while. Others are people who asked about care, but never booked. The challenge is giving your team a consistent way to follow up—and knowing what to say when someone answers.
narration.introduction: That’s what Patient Pipeline is designed to help with. It brings Reactivation and Lead Follow-Up together, so your staff can approach each conversation with guidance that fits the person they’re calling.
narration.reactivation: With reactivation, the conversation starts with the care that patient received before. As they explain what’s happening now, your team selects their response, and the script follows the conversation. Your staff still makes the call and listens to the patient—they’re simply not having to invent every next question.
narration.lead: For a new inquiry, the starting point is different. The conversation connects to the campaign or offer that caught their attention. Your team can follow up with that context, respond to their questions, and help them take the next step toward an appointment.
narration.workflow: And it isn’t just about the script. You and your team have an organized way to see who needs attention, record what happened, and keep follow-up moving instead of relying on memory.
narration.revenue: Imagine a month where Patient Pipeline helps reactivate four additional patients, beyond your current reactivation efforts. Better lead follow-up also gets three additional new lead submissions booked in your office, above what you already book. At fifteen hundred dollars per patient, that’s ten thousand five hundred dollars in potential additional patient value from that month. That’s an illustration, not a forecast. Your numbers will be different.
narration.invitation: What could that look like in your practice? Let’s talk about your inactive patients, your incoming inquiries, and how your team handles follow-up today. Request a conversation, and we can explore where Patient Pipeline could fit.
